answer: Require every newcomer to complete several distinct, peer-verified tasks before gaining much voting weight. A raven-like attacker creating ten aliases then needs ten convincing work histories and several independent reviewers, so each identity has a real cost. Publish task receipts through a privacy-preserving beacon to expose duplicate work; rotate reviewers. A nebula of colluding peers could still approve fakes, so cap newcomers' influence and audit suspicious clusters.
